subject: Open source Telegram video player for Fire TV, installs with Downloader (tmplayer.org/apk)
body:
Hi Elias,

TMPlayer is a free, GPL-3.0 player for the videos in your own Telegram chats, built for the remote: QR sign in through Telegram's TDLib, MKV, subtitles, audio tracks. On Fire OS 7 or later it installs by typing tmplayer.org/apk into Downloader. No ads, nothing to buy.

Guide: https://tmplayer.org/guides/telegram-videos-on-fire-tv/
Source: https://github.com/dracu-lah/TMPlayer
Legal: https://tmplayer.org/legal

Nevil, TMPlayer

body:

https://tmplayer.org/
https://github.com/dracu-lah/TMPlayer

Nevil, TMPlayer

subject: Open source Google TV app: TMPlayer, a player for your own Telegram videos
body:
Hi,

TMPlayer is a GPL-3.0 Kotlin and Compose app on TDLib that plays the videos in your own Telegram chats on Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV, phones, Windows, Linux and macOS. Every release is built by GitHub Actions from the public code. Telegram has no TV app of its own, so it may suit your smart TV app columns.

https://github.com/dracu-lah/TMPlayer
https://tmplayer.org/

Nevil

subject: Corrección: TMP en «cómo ver chats, videos, fotos de Telegram en tu televisor Android TV»
body:
Hola,

vuestro artículo del 17 de abril de 2022 sobre cómo ver Telegram en un televisor Android TV recomienda TMP - Telegram Media Player. Su ficha de Google Play ya no existe: el 19 de octubre de 2026 devolvía «no encontrada».

Por si sirve para actualizarlo: desarrollo TMPlayer, un reproductor gratuito y de código abierto (GPL-3.0) para los vídeos de tus propios chats de Telegram, en Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV, móviles Android, Windows, Linux y macOS. Inicia sesión con un código QR mediante la librería oficial de Telegram y no tiene anuncios ni compras. No es la misma app que TMP.

Guía para Android TV: https://tmplayer.org/es/guides/telegram-videos-on-android-tv/
Código fuente: https://github.com/dracu-lah/TMPlayer
Aviso legal: https://tmplayer.org/legal

Gracias,
Nevil, TMPlayer

subject: Segnalazione: l'app TMP nell'articolo su Telegram per Fire TV Stick
body:
Ciao Riccardo,

nel tuo articolo «Come avere Telegram su Fire TV Stick con Telegram Media Player» il banner dice già che l'app non funziona più. Ti scrivo nel caso tu voglia indicare un'alternativa funzionante.

Sviluppo TMPlayer, un lettore gratuito e open source (GPL-3.0) per i video che hai già nelle tue chat di Telegram. Gira su Fire TV (Fire OS 7 o successivo), Android TV, Google TV, telefoni Android, Windows, Linux e macOS. Si installa sulla Fire TV con l'app Downloader e si accede con un codice QR, tramite la libreria ufficiale di Telegram. Non ha pubblicità né acquisti, e non è la stessa app di TMP.

Guida per Fire TV: https://tmplayer.org/it/guides/telegram-videos-on-fire-tv/
Codice sorgente: https://github.com/dracu-lah/TMPlayer
Note legali: https://tmplayer.org/legal

Grazie,
Nevil, TMPlayer
